fields.name: Dhaval Mahajan
fields.description: Dhaval brings over 10 years of experience in real estate and business consulting. He founded Aai Bhavani Consultant with a vision to simplify property transactions and deliver trusted services under one roof.

fields.name: Mukund Patil
fields.description: Mukund oversees day-to-day operations and client relationships. His background in finance and project management ensures every client gets a seamless, end-to-end experience.

fields.review: Aai Bhavani helped us find our dream home in Surat within 3 weeks. Dhaval personally guided us through every step — from shortlisting to registration. Highly recommended!
Got my home loan approved within 10 days at a rate lower than what my bank quoted. The team handled all the paperwork — I just had to sign.
Our office interior was transformed completely within the budget and timeline. The design team understood exactly what we wanted. Very professional and creative.
Referred my colleague for a property deal and earned a great commission. The referral process was smooth and the payout was on time. Will definitely refer more people!

fields.question: What services does Aai Bhavani Consultant offer?
fields.answer: We offer Property Consulting (buy/sell/rent), Home Loan assistance, Interior Design, Digital Marketing, and IT Services — all under one roof in Surat.

fields.question: Is there any fee for property search?
fields.answer: No. Property search and initial consultation are completely free. Our fee is only applicable on successful deal closure, which is standard industry practice.

fields.question: How does the referral program work?
fields.answer: Simply share a friend or family member's name and number with us. If they close a deal, you earn a commission — up to 50% profit share on property deals. No investment required.

fields.question: How quickly can I get a home loan approved?
fields.answer: With our bank partnerships, most home loans are approved within 7–15 working days, subject to document verification. We handle the entire process so you don't have to visit the bank.

fields.question: Do you work in cities outside Surat?
fields.answer: We are currently based in Surat but handle referrals and digital services across Gujarat. For other cities, contact us and we will connect you with our network partners.
